briefdescription.para: Move to the state right before the next MI or after the end of MBB.

detaileddescription.para: returns false if reached end of the block. If UseInternalIterator is true, then internal iterators are used and set to process in program order. If UseInternalIterator is false, then it is assumed that the tracker is using an externally managed iterator, and advance* calls will not update the state of the iterator. In such cases, the tracker will move to the state right before the provided MI and use LIS for RP calculations.
